## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 is the DILUTION-CC unconditional-discharge leg — the Volovik tracking-vacuum (C10) sign/BBN cluster. The substrate IS the Volovik q-theory vacuum: the cosmological constant is the spectral-action zeroth moment a₀ (`a_0_FW_zeta = 6440.0`), a DIFFERENT moment than gravity (a₂). C10 is currently `ASSUMED-PARTIALLY-PROVEN` in Atlas-04 — the tracking scaling `rho_vac ~ M_Pl² H²` (exponent n=2) is posited at the substrate-IS level (Volovik q-theory: `rho_vac(q) = ε(q) − q dε/dq`, Paper 13 Eq.4 / Paper 25 Eq.2.11). Three gates close the remaining legs:

- **V.2 (`S98-W2-2-RELAXATION-CLOSURE`)** — the single remaining Object-C leg for an UNCONDITIONAL discharge: derive the `q~H` relaxation map from the substrate cosmological-friction ODE `q″ + 3Hq′ + V′(q)=0` (V = δρ_vac from the D_K spectrum) rather than ASSUMING the linear slow-roll attractor, and test whether `d ln q/d ln H = 1` (⇒ n=2) emerges UNFORCED. **HARD-ORDERED after Wave 1** — consumes the route-selected substrate H(τ) AOFT backbone.
- **V.9 (`S98-MK3-1-C10-SUBLEADING-SIGN`)** — the cheap regression lead, INDEPENDENT of W1: on the existing `s97_w2_2_c10_n_exponent.npz` (audit `b69da9f4`), scan the C10 sub-leading divergence toward q→0 and emit `divergence_type∈{A,B}` + `C_meas_well_conditioned∈{True,False}` to pin (or fail to pin) the sub-leading `n_eff=1.978` (approach-from-below) sign.
- **V.10 (`S98-MK3-2-BBN-VACUUM-FRACTION`)** — after V.9: propagate `n_eff=1.978` into the BBN-epoch vacuum-energy fraction, resolve WHICH epoch lever X enters `rho_vac/rho_rad`, and test against the BBN bound. Consumes V.9's conditioning flag.

Carry-forward source: `session-97-w2-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (V.2) + `workshops/w-1-c10-composite-collapse-adjudication.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (mack×volovik: V.9 CF-MK3-1, V.10 CF-MK3-2, the V.2 two-sub-gate framing).

### V.2 prereq-block decision point (W1 → W2 HARD ORDERING — PRE-REGISTERED)

The relaxation-closure friction ODE `q″ + 3Hq′ + V′(q)=0` consumes the substrate Hubble backbone H(τ). H(τ) is **route-CONDITIONAL** (VOL / GFT / AOFT acoustic frames) until Wave 1 (V.1) selects the AOFT canonical frame. Planning V.2 independent of V.1 would feed it a route-ambiguous H(τ) — the CC discharge would inherit the very ambiguity V.1 resolves (`session-98-context.md §IV.4 constraint 1`).

**Decision point (pre-registered, anticipated at plan-authorship time per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"When mechanical closure IS acceptable"` item 1):**

- **IF** `S98-W1-ROUTE-RECONCILIATION` Clause-2 verdict (AOFT-frame H(τ) / q_Ω) is **PASS** at V.2 dispatch time → V.2 runs the full friction-ODE attractor computation consuming the route-selected H(τ).
- **IF** `S98-W1-ROUTE-RECONCILIATION` is **FAIL / INFO / UNCOMPUTED** at V.2 dispatch time → V.2 honestly closes via mechanical closure: emit `FAIL -- value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_S98-W1-ROUTE-RECONCILIATION_<status>'`, update the working-paper §W2-1 Status/Verdict/Results/Substrate-framing blocks IN-SCRIPT, and route the full V.2 computation as a `CF-S99` carry-forward conditional on W1 landing PASS. Per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` item 2 the closure verdict is FAIL/PRE-REG-INC, NEVER PASS; per item 3 the closure pinmap embeds per-gate identity keys for a distinct `audit_sha256`; per item 5 the working-paper update is in the same run.

This is NOT post-hoc plan editing (Class-3): the prereq-block scenario is anticipated HERE at plan-freeze, and the closure script (`computations/_shared/s98_w2_pre_reg_inc_closure.py`, canonical pattern) is pre-authorized. The orchestrator at `/rclab-coordinate` time MUST close Wave 1 before V.2 dispatches; everything else in Wave 2 (V.9, V.10) pipelines independently.

# (6) audit_discriminators

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "d ln q/d ln H = 1 ⇔ rho_vac ~ H² (tracking exponent n=2), and this slope emerges
            UNFORCED from the friction ODE — it is NOT put in by hand."

    Step 1: V(q) = δρ_vac(q) = E_ZP(q) − E_ZP(q0), with E_ZP(q) = (1/2) Σ_n omega_n(q)(2 N_n^GGE + 1) d_n
            and omega_n(q) = sqrt(lambda_n² + q)   [S62 zero-point; npz omega_s, deg_s, n_k_gge, w_n].
            Near the tracking fixed point: V(q) ≈ rho0_ref + (1/2) k_curv (q − q0_ref)²,
            k_curv = d²E/dq²|₀ = +3586.5   [npz d2E_dq2_0; canonical_constants a_0-channel].
            ⇒ V′(q) = k_curv (q − q0_ref).

    Step 2: Friction ODE in cosmic time: q″ + 3H q′ + V′(q) = 0.
            Overdamped (tracking) limit 3H q′ ≫ q″: 3H q′ = −k_curv (q − q0_ref).
            Re-express in e-fold time N (dN = H dt): 3 H² dq/dN = −k_curv (q − q0_ref).

    Step 3: Linearize about the tracking fixed point q* (let u = q − q*):
            du/dN = −[k_curv / (3 H²)] u.
            d ln H/dN = −(1 + q_decel) ≡ decel_factor   [KINEMATIC, set by the AOFT H(τ);
            w-INDEPENDENT — supplied by Wave-1 route-selected backbone].

    Step 4: Substitute and simplify (Sage-verified at plan-freeze):
            d ln q/d ln H = (d ln u/dN)/(d ln H/dN)
                          = [−k_curv/(3 H²)] / decel_factor
                          = −k_curv / (3 H²·decel_factor).
            Direction read-off: the slope is set by the RATIO of the substrate potential curvature
            k_curv to the kinematic Hubble-friction factor 3 H²·decel. Sage confirms
            ∂(slope)/∂(V-normalization w) = −k_curv/(3 H²·decel) ≠ 0 ⇒ the slope is genuinely
            dynamical (NOT a trivial L_max-prefactor cancellation).

    Step 5: PASS ⇔ slope = 1 ± 0.05 ⇔ −k_curv/(3 H²·decel_factor) = 1 at the late-time attractor.
            This balance is NOT guaranteed; it emerges (or fails to) from the substrate k_curv
            (fixed by the D_K spectrum) AND the AOFT-frame H(τ) decel (fixed by Wave 1). If it
            lands at 1 UNFORCED ⇒ n=2 is fully substrate-forced ⇒ C10 Object C DONE.

    Conclusion: The gate computes the emergent attractor slope by log-log regression of the FULL
    second-order ODE trajectory (NOT the Step-2 overdamped shortcut — that is the analytic
    cross-check only). PASS iff |slope − 1| ≤ 0.05 with no free closure parameter. A free closure
    parameter (an unpinned IC degree of freedom that the slope depends on) ⇒ FAIL/INFO.

            measured GGE-correction C_meas(q) converges to a well-conditioned q³-coefficient as
            q→0 with shrinking residual."

    Step 1: n_eff = 2 + Σ_k (dp_k/dH) n_k / (Σ_k omega_k n_k)   [S66 T.61; npz n_eff_T61].
            The +correction sign sets approach-from-ABOVE (n_eff>2) or -correction sign sets
            approach-from-BELOW (n_eff<2). npz: C_direct=C_meas=−0.0219 (measured) and
            C_modesum=C_T61=+0.0297 (gap-set). n_eff stored = 1.978 < 2 ⇒ from-BELOW under the
            MEASURED leg.

    Step 2: Window-shrink toward q→0. Fit q³-coefficient a₃^meas(window) and a₃^T61(window) by
            polyfit on each shrinking window. divergence_type is decoded by the EMERGENCE-1 table:
              - TYPE-A: a₃^meas CONVERGES (|Δa₃^meas|/|a₃^meas| < 0.10 across last two halvings)
                ⇒ the sub-leading correction is a genuine substrate prediction (q→0 limit exists,
                   robust to the GGE occupation n_k choice).
              - TYPE-B: a₃^meas DIVERGES or is occupation-sensitive (the two legs C_meas vs C_T61
                disagree in SIGN and neither converges) ⇒ artifact of the specific n_k.

    Step 3: C_meas_well_conditioned is decoded by the residual ratio:
              residual_ratio = (regression residual on TIGHT window)/(residual on WIDE window).
              < 1 ⇒ residual SHRINKING ⇒ well-conditioned (True).
              ≥ 1 ⇒ residual not shrinking ⇒ ill-conditioned (False).

    Step 4: Direction read-off. PASS (sign + BBN-direction PINNED) ⇔ divergence_type==A AND

            prediction the V.10 BBN gate can consume directionally.

    the cached estimators via the pre-registered truth-table. PASS pins the sign; INFO (B∧True)
    leaves it directional-but-soft; FAIL (C_meas ill-conditioned) leaves it undetermined.

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Whether the from-below n_eff=1.978 RELIEVES or WORSENS the BBN vacuum over-contribution
            is set by the SIGN of (n_eff−2)·ln(H_BBN/H_0); it is NOT a given. The context-file
            'smaller n_eff dilutes FASTER ⇒ LESS vacuum at BBN' framing is a HYPOTHESIS to test."

    Step 1: rho_vac(H) = alpha_V M_Pl² H^{n_eff}   [S73b: rho_vac = alpha_V M_Pl² H²; S66 generalized
            to exponent n_eff]. Present epoch: rho_vac(H_0)/rho_obs = 1.032   [DILUTION-CC-66 canonical].
            ⇒ alpha_V M_Pl² H_0^{n_eff} = 1.032 rho_obs fixes the normalization.

    Step 2: rho_rad(H) scales as the radiation density during BBN. In radiation domination
            rho_rad ∝ a^{-4} and H² ∝ rho_rad ⇒ rho_rad ∝ H². Therefore
            rho_vac/rho_rad = [alpha_V M_Pl² H^{n_eff}] / [c_rad H²] ∝ H^{n_eff − 2}.

    Step 3: Ratio at BBN vs present:
            (rho_vac/rho_rad)_BBN / (rho_vac/rho_rad)_0 = (H_BBN/H_0)^{n_eff − 2}.
            H_BBN ≫ H_0 ⇒ ln(H_BBN/H_0) ≫ 0 (large positive; ~ tens of e-folds, the log10 X lever).

    Step 4: Substitute and read off the DIRECTION:
            (rho_vac/rho_rad)_BBN ∝ (H_BBN/H_0)^{n_eff−2}.
            - n_eff = 2 EXACTLY: exponent 0 ⇒ rho_vac/rho_rad CONSTANT (= present 1.032-normalized) ⇒
              vacuum tracks radiation perfectly ⇒ the S66 baseline alpha(BBN)=0.67 case.
            - n_eff = 1.978 < 2: exponent (n_eff−2) = −0.022 < 0, and ln(H_BBN/H_0) > 0 ⇒
              (H_BBN/H_0)^{−0.022} < 1 ⇒ (rho_vac/rho_rad)_BBN < (rho_vac/rho_rad)_0.
              ⇒ the from-below correction DOES dilute the vacuum FASTER at high H ⇒ LESS vacuum at
              BBN ⇒ RELIEF. The context-file direction is CONFIRMED by the substitution chain —
              BUT only because (n_eff−2)<0 AND ln(H_BBN/H_0)>0; the gate VERIFIES both signs
              numerically, it does not assume them.

    Step 5: Magnitude test. relief_factor = (H_BBN/H_0)^{(n_eff−2)} evaluated at the SINGLE
            substrate-justified epoch lever X = ln(H_BBN/H_0) (BBN rad-dom, z~10^9). Then
            (rho_vac/rho_rad)_BBN = 1.032 · relief_factor · (rho_obs/rho_rad,BBN-normalization).
            PASS iff this lands <= bbn_vacuum_fraction_bound=0.227 AND V.9 returned type-A∧clean
            (so the from-below SIGN that drives the relief is PINNED, not assumed).

    Conclusion: The relief DIRECTION is derived (Step 4), the relief MAGNITUDE is the gate's test
    (Step 5). PASS iff relief sufficient AND sign pinned. INFO iff relief directional-but-weaker
    (V.9 type-B). UNDETERMINED iff V.9 ill-conditioned. Note the S66 baseline "n_eff<2 EXCLUDED" was
    computed at a DIFFERENT (n_eff held fixed, large) departure — the gate quantifies the actual
    −0.022 shift, which is a SMALL relief; whether it is SUFFICIENT relief is the open numerical test.

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 3 (matter sector: Yukawa ε_LX + baryogenesis) is INDEPENDENT of Wave 2 (no Wave-3 gate consumes a Wave-2 output). No cross-wave hand-off from W2 to W3. The only consumer of Wave-2 outputs is the OPTIONAL Wave-2-internal (β) sub-gate and the Atlas-04 C10 / capstone §8.5 status update at session-synthesis.

**Internal Wave-2 orderings + downstream dispositions (per gate, all PASS/FAIL/INFO branches):**

| Gate | Verdict | Downstream action |
|:-----|:--------|:------------------|
| **V.9** | PASS (A∧True) | Sign PINNED → V.10 dispatches consuming a HARD from-below direction; record `divergence_type=A` in the V.10 conditioning input. |
| **V.9** | INFO (B∧True) | Sign SOFT → V.10 dispatches with explicit soft-caveat (V.10 verdict capped at INFO). |
| **V.9** | FAIL (C_meas False) | Sign UNDETERMINED → V.10 emits the pre-registered `UNDETERMINED` (INFO-token, registry state named); the BBN fraction is reported but unsigned. |
| **V.10** | PASS | From-below relief SUFFICIENT + sign pinned → at session-synthesis, route a Window-8 / BBN-VOLOVIK-67 status-strengthening note (mack-cosmic-bridge sole writer of the falsifier surface per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`); capstone-hygiene Q3 (PROVEN/CONDITIONAL status change) fires → reconcile capstone §8.5 + Atlas-04 C10. |
| **V.10** | FAIL | Residual BBN tension → Window-8 flagged still-open; route a CF-S99 (quantify the additional relief needed). Capstone-hygiene Q3 fires (C10 status unchanged-but-flagged). |
| **V.10** | INFO/UNDETERMINED | BBN arm computed, verdict inherits V.9 conditioning → no capstone status change; route a CF-S99 to re-extract the V.9 sign at finer q-resolution. |
| **V.2** | PASS | n=2 SUBSTRATE-FORCED → C10 Object C DONE → the optional (β) BBN-EXPONENT-SENSITIVITY sub-gate may fire as a wave-AND (V.2-α ∧ V.2-β) IF V.10 has landed; capstone §8.5 OPEN→CLOSED + Atlas-04 C10 toward PROVEN (capstone-hygiene Q3 fires). |
| **V.2** | FAIL | n=2 NOT substrate-forced → C10 stays ASSUMED-PARTIALLY-PROVEN; the unconditional-discharge corridor closes; route a CF-S99 (alternative C10 closure path). |
| **V.2** | INFO / PRE-REG-INC | EITHER slope informative-but-not-1 (route CF-S99), OR Wave-1 prereq-block (mechanical closure; full V.2 → CF-S99 conditional on W1 PASS). |

**Optional (β) sub-gate framing (V.2-β, BBN-EXPONENT-SENSITIVITY):** the W-1 workshop two-sub-gate framing is `(α) RELAXATION-CLOSURE ∧ (β) BBN-EXPONENT-SENSITIVITY` combined by logical AND. (β) tests whether the V.10 BBN fraction survives JOINTLY with the V.2-derived relaxation. (β) is GATED on BOTH V.2-α PASS AND V.10 landing; if either is absent it does not fire (deferred to CF-S99). A wave-AND PASS (V.2-α ∧ V.2-β) is the structural precondition for any future C10 `ASSUMED-PARTIALLY-PROVEN → CONFIRMED` Atlas-04 tag. This is a parallel-compute-wave structure (two independent axes + AND closeout per `Investigating-Workshops.md §Q3`), NOT a separate gate-ID this session — it is recorded here as the forward-disposition for the next session if both V.2-α and V.10 PASS.
